prompt: Can you make it possible for customers to download their invoices as CSV files?
why: An ordinary feature request without a leading implementation verb.

prompt: We need the results table to show twenty rows at a time, with next and previous buttons. Please make that happen.
why: A clearly scoped user interface feature.

prompt: The application exits whenever the input file is empty. Can you work out what is going wrong?
why: A request to diagnose a concrete failure.

prompt: Two workers each hold a lock that the other needs and neither makes progress. Please figure out the cause and a repair.
why: Concurrency investigation described without the word deadlock.

prompt: I need a complete language toolchain, from parsing to optimization and native code generation. Build it from scratch.
why: Broad system construction warrants higher reasoning.

prompt: The compiler settings page needs a reset button that restores its existing defaults. Could you put one there?
why: Local interface work in a compiler project.

prompt: The sign-in button currently says Sing in. Please correct that label only.
why: A mechanical label correction in a consequential area.

prompt: People must only be able to open invoices belonging to their own organization. Make the endpoint enforce that.
why: A consequential access-control change described without domain keywords.

prompt: In two short sentences, tell me what it means when two threads are waiting for locks held by each other.
why: A bounded conceptual explanation rather than an investigation.

prompt: Give me three bullet points covering the supplied release note. Do not research or change anything.
why: A short summary request.

prompt: Please execute the existing lint command and tell me whether it passes. Leave the code alone.
why: An existing check with no interpretation or fix requested.

prompt: Should this queue live in memory or in a persistent database? We need to survive restarts. Explain the tradeoffs.
why: An architectural choice with tradeoffs.

prompt: Look over this patch for correctness and maintainability before I merge it.
why: Ordinary review expressed without a leading review verb.

prompt: The title is 'Investigate the production deadlock'. Change its capitalization to sentence case only.
why: A literal text edit, not investigation of the quoted incident.

prompt: Do not start building the database yet. Just give me a one-sentence definition of an index.
why: The requested work is a bounded definition.

prompt: First correct the label typo, then find out why the service crashes on empty input.
why: The investigation dominates the mechanical change.

prompt: Can you take care of that?
why: Insufficient context to select a new work profile.

prompt: Thanks!
why: No new task.

prompt: Customers should be able to download their invoices as CSV. Can you make that possible?
why: Clear implementation can escalate an unpinned easy task.

prompt: It still exits on an empty file. Please work out the underlying cause.
why: A diagnosis request can increase reasoning.

prompt: Run the existing tests.
why: An existing check retains the current phase.

prompt: Give me a one-sentence explanation of the result.
why: A short explanation does not automatically reduce an ongoing selection.

prompt: Summarize these 30 release notes.
why: An explicitly sized summary batch can reduce selection.

prompt: Implement the approved plan.
why: An explicit approved-plan transition can reduce effort.
